faq_section.title: Answers to the questions you ask
faq_section.subtitle: Can't find your question? Feel free to call us or schedule a no-obligation introductory meeting.

faq.q: How long does it take to switch to VvE Beheer Collectief?
faq.a: We usually arrange a complete switch within 6 to 8 weeks. We handle the administrative transfer entirely — from terminating with the current manager to setting up your client portal.

faq.q: What exactly does the Complete package include?
faq.a: The Complete package combines administrative, financial and technical management in one fixed monthly fee. Including ALV organisation, annual accounts, MJOP maintenance, 24/7 damage reporting and a dedicated contact person.

faq.q: Do we get one dedicated contact person?
faq.a: Yes. Every VvE is assigned a dedicated manager who knows your building, residents and history. In case of absence, there is always a substitute who is familiar with your file.

faq.q: How transparent is the client portal?
faq.a: Fully. All owners can see their own financial position, all meeting documents, the MJOP, outstanding maintenance items and the VvE's cash flow — available 24/7, without needing to contact us.

faq.q: Do you also offer legal management?
faq.a: No. For legal matters we work with specialised VvE lawyers whom we are happy to introduce you to. This way you keep one contact point for coordination, while receiving genuine specialist expertise for the legal work.

overons_page.title: Based in Wateringen, active throughout South Holland
overons_page.desc: VvE Beheer Collectief was founded in 2009 with the conviction that VvE management can be more personal, more transparent and more proactive. Over the past 17 years, we have grown into one of the established names in the region, with more than 500 VvE's under management.
overons_page.team_subtitle: A small team of experienced specialists. Every VvE is assigned one dedicated manager.
overons_page.missie_quote: VvE management that relieves rather than complicates.
overons_page.missie_desc: We see VvE management as a relationship of trust. That is why we invest in small portfolios per manager, our own client portal and short lines of communication. No call centres, no automated responses — just a team that knows your building.

privacy_page.title: Privacy statement
privacy_page.intro: VvE Beheer Collectief, based in Wateringen, is responsible for the processing of personal data as set out in this privacy statement.
privacy_page.gegevens_intro: VvE Beheer Collectief processes your personal data because you use our services and/or because you provide this data to us yourself. Below you will find an overview of the personal data we process:
gegevens_items: Name and address of your VvE
Other data you actively provide, for example via correspondence or the quote form
privacy_page.doel_intro: VvE Beheer Collectief processes your personal data for the following purposes:
doel_items: To be able to call or email you if necessary to carry out our services
Performing VvE management services for which you have engaged us
To inform you about changes to our services
privacy_page.h2_bewaren: How long we retain personal data
privacy_page.bewaren_text: VvE Beheer Collectief does not retain your personal data longer than strictly necessary to achieve the purposes for which your data is collected. Data from quote requests is retained for a maximum of 12 months if no agreement follows. In the case of an active management agreement, data is retained for the duration and up to 7 years thereafter (statutory retention period for financial administration).
privacy_page.h2_derden: Sharing personal data with third parties
privacy_page.derden_text: VvE Beheer Collectief does not share your data with third parties unless this is necessary for the execution of our agreement with you or to comply with a legal obligation.
privacy_page.inzien_text: You have the right to view, correct or delete your personal data. You also have the right to withdraw any consent for data processing or to object to the processing. You can send a request for access, correction, deletion or transfer of your personal data to info@vvebeheercollectief.nl.
privacy_page.beveiliging_text: VvE Beheer Collectief takes the protection of your data seriously and takes appropriate measures to prevent misuse, loss, unauthorised access, unwanted disclosure and unauthorised modification. If you feel that your data is not properly secured or there are indications of misuse, please contact us at info@vvebeheercollectief.nl.

items: Contractor: VvE Beheer Collectief, based in Wateringen, registered at the KvK under number 51721139.
Client: the Association of Owners (VvE) entering into an agreement with the Contractor.
Agreement: the management agreement between the Client and the Contractor.

articles.p: These general terms and conditions apply to every offer by the Contractor and to every agreement entered into. Deviations from these terms and conditions are only valid if expressly agreed upon in writing.

All quotes from VvE Beheer Collectief are without obligation and valid for a period of 30 days, unless stated otherwise. An agreement is concluded upon written confirmation by both parties or by a resolution of the ALV.

VvE Beheer Collectief will execute the agreement to the best of its knowledge and ability, in accordance with the requirements of good workmanship. The manager has an obligation of effort and not an obligation of result.

The management agreement is entered into for the duration as stated in the agreement. Termination is done in writing, observing a notice period of 3 months before the end of the contract period, unless otherwise agreed.

All stated rates are exclusive of VAT, unless expressly stated otherwise. Payment must be made within 30 days after the invoice date. In case of late payment, the Client is in default by operation of law and statutory interest is due.

The liability of VvE Beheer Collectief is limited to the amount paid out by the professional liability insurance in the case concerned, plus the deductible. If the insurance does not pay out, the liability is limited to the amount of the fee that the Contractor received for its work under the agreement over the period of 12 months prior to the event causing the damage.

Both parties are obliged to maintain confidentiality of all confidential information obtained from each other in the context of the agreement. This obligation also applies after termination of the agreement.
Complaints about the execution of the agreement must be submitted to VvE Beheer Collectief in a timely, complete and clearly described manner. Complaints are processed within 14 days of receipt.
Dutch law applies to all agreements between the Client and VvE Beheer Collectief. Disputes are submitted to the competent court in the district of The Hague.
